messages:
Marcus: Quick async standup — model onboarding slot.
Marcus: Yesterday: finished tokenizer edge-case for es-CL, ran full eval set (2k examples) against tinyq-1. Results: F1 regressed 1.8% on addresses. Blockers: seeing inconsistent tokenization when prefix contains non-breaking spaces; need a deterministic normalizer.
Anya: Can you paste an example of the input that fails?
Marcus: sure — "Calle 12 #5" vs "Calle 12 #5". Tokenizer currently keeps NBSP -> different subword split.
Kai: I hit a similar issue in the spanish promptset last week. We added a normalizer in the ingest pipeline that folds NBSP to space. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/342
Marcus: Nice — will try that patch locally. If it fixes, I'll rerun evals and push new model variant.
Sasha: Note on gating: if rerun improves F1 by >1% on address subset, we can promote to canary. We should also run inference latency smoke on dedicated to ensure quantization didn't regress.
eval-bot: Automated evals completed: tinyq-1 full run — baseline 0.912, current 0.895, delta -0.017. Full logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/1719812468
Marcus: plan for today: try ingest patch, rerun tokenizer, re-eval, open PR for model variant; need someone to pair for canary rollout docs (small runbook).
Anya: I can pair at 11:30 PT. Ping me when you have a repro.
Kai: I'll run a latency smoke on dedicated for tinyq-1 once Marcus posts the new model artifact. ETA ~after lunch.
Marcus: assigning to self to cut the model artifact. Will post PR link in thread when ready.
Sasha: small reminder — include the promptset version in the model metadata (promptset:v3.4) so metrics map correctly.
Marcus: ack, adding.
Anya: quick code-review ping: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1282 — left a minor comment about kv_cache shards.
Marcus: thanks, will address today.
Kai: blocker for me: can't access the ded. cluster for smoke, hitting 403 from deploy role. @infra-team any chance to unblock?
Sasha: looping infra — @infra-team can you help with temp role for Kai? :pray:
infra-bot: Ticket #INC-91234 opened to grant deploy role to kai. ETA 2h.
Kai: thanks.
Marcus: final — will post success/fail notes here. If rerun still regresses, we may need to revert quantization changes and open a hotfix.
Anya: :thumbsup:
Kai: :ok_hand:
Marcus: (after) Update: applying ingest patch fixed NBSP normalization; re-eval shows F1 +1.4% vs current, latency unchanged. PR for new variant: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1284
Sasha: great — proceed with canary following runbook.
Marcus: will start canary at 17:00 PT and ping ops channel before traffic shift.
